summary: Frontend-only test of the DashboardReturn bar (testID back-to-dashboard-button). PASS: when a jeweller admin is signed in, the bar shows at the top of /build, /, /shop, /account, /try-on/<id>, /product/<id>, /merchant and /build?leadId=6ad9f29faac432ffa67dae70 at both 390x844 and 1280x800. It is the topmost element (elementFromPoint), sits in the normal layout (40px tall, y=0), and does not cover builder content or the tab bar: the document height equals the viewport, the tab bar bottom is 838.5/844 and 787.5/800, and the Save design CTA and tabs are visible. Pressing it goes to /admin and the admin-shell shows. Hidden on /admin, /admin/catalog, /admin/leads/<id>, /platform, /job-sheet/<id> and for logged-out visitors on /build. Iframe scenario passed: the app was loaded at /admin?embedded=1 inside a host-page iframe. Sign-in worked, and both Open builder (admin-nav-open-builder) and lead Pro builder (lead-pro-builder-button) reached /build with the bar visible; the bar returned to /admin each time, so no refresh is needed. ONE REAL BUG: the bar calls router.replace('/admin'), so each dashboard->builder->back cycle adds another mounted admin screen to the stack. The admin-shell count went 2→3→4→5 over 4 cycles and history.length grew too. This leaves duplicate hidden admin screens with duplicate testIDs and extra query subscriptions, and makes browser Back behave oddly.

ui_bugs.issue: router.replace('/admin') stacks a new admin screen on top of the existing one, which stays mounted but hidden. After N round-trips there are N+1 mounted AdminShell instances (measured 2,3,4,5). This leaks memory and polling queries and duplicates testIDs: the first [data-testid=admin-nav-open-builder] became a hidden element. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/dashboard-return.tsx:16

issues: minHeight 40 is below the 44pt touch-target minimum. Use 44 or add hitSlop.
The bar loads in after the async admin session restore (fetchMe), so storefront content jumps down 40px on first paint for signed-in admins (minor layout shift).
Row has no flexShrink/numberOfLines on the hint text, so on very narrow widths (<340px) the hint could overflow. Add numberOfLines={1} and flexShrink:1 to the hint.

design_issues.screen: /try-on/[id] at 1280x800 (pre-existing, not caused by the bar)
issues: Stage is full width with aspectRatio 0.8, so on desktop it is about 1500px tall and the Take/Upload photo buttons sit at y≈1660, far below the fold. Cap the stage at a maxWidth or maxHeight on wide screens.

action_items: In DashboardReturn, replace router.replace('/admin') with router.dismissTo('/admin' as never) (available in expo-router 57) so it pops back to the existing admin screen instead of stacking a new one. Alternatively: if canGoBack and the previous route is /admin*, call router.back(); otherwise replace. Then re-check that admin-shell count stays 1 after several round-trips.
Raise the bar's minHeight to 44 (touch target), and add numberOfLines={1} and flexShrink:1 to the hint text.
(Optional, pre-existing) Constrain the try-on stage height on desktop widths.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard-return.tsx: The hide regex /^\/(admin|platform|job-sheet)/ is correct for current routes, but it would also match a hypothetical '/administrator' route. /^\/(admin|platform|job-sheet)(\/|$)/ is safer.
The bar depends only on the admin AuthProvider session, so customers (customer session) never see it. This matches the requirement.
The ?embedded=1 query param is not read anywhere in the frontend and is dropped on return (/admin). This is harmless now; note it if embedded-specific behaviour is planned.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all visibility, navigation and layout checks pass; stack-growth bug on return)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login at /admin: first input = email, input[type=password], press Enter; wait for [data-testid=admin-shell]. After a back-to-dashboard round-trip, multiple admin-shell nodes exist (bug), so use :visible selectors. Lead id 6ad9f29faac432ffa67dae70 and product id shop-10762101948438 are valid. For the iframe test, use page.set_content with <iframe src=BASE/admin?embedded=1> and frame_locator('#f'). No AI generations were triggered.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: sign in at /admin, then Open builder, then Back to dashboard, repeated N times. Count [data-testid=admin-shell] nodes: you get N+1. Root cause: the admin screen pushes /build, and router.replace('/admin') swaps /build for a NEW admin route instead of popping to the existing one. Mitigation: router.dismissTo('/admin').
